rec.name: Cart Promo Banner (Automatic Quantity Discount Message)
rec.status: Built — in use on a client store; product-specific targeting unconfirmed

what.text: A promotional banner shown in the cart that communicates an active offer. The discount itself is not hard-coded into the banner: it is applied through Shopify's native automatic discount feature, set up as a quantity-based discount. The banner is presumably the visible message layer for that discount (e.g. 'buy X, save Y').

why.text: Showing the offer at the point of purchase makes the saving explicit and reassures the shopper that the discount will be applied. Quantity-based promos nudge shoppers to add more units, which raises AOV. Because the discount is automatic, there is no code to find or type, which removes checkout friction and the 'hunting for a code' drop-off.

how.text: 1) In Shopify Admin > Discounts, create an automatic discount of the quantity-based type (e.g. buy X items, get a % or amount off). 2) Add the promo banner to the cart template/section in the theme, with the message copy matching the discount rules. 3) Shopify applies the discount to the cart price automatically when the conditions are met. Whether a banner can be scoped per product is NOT confirmed in the ticket: the dev only confirmed the discount is a standard quantity-based automatic discount. Per-product scoping would need the automatic discount to be restricted to specific products/collections plus conditional banner logic, which is an assumption.

items: Underlying Shopify automatic discount: type, quantity threshold, value, eligible products/collections (configured in Shopify Admin, not the theme)
Possible: banner colors / icon (not confirmed in source)

dependencies.text: Requires Shopify's native automatic discounts (quantity-based) set up in the store admin; the developer who built it had no access to this client's discount settings. Theme must support a cart template/section where the banner can be placed. No app or metafield dependency is mentioned.

items: Share of orders with the automatic discount applied
